svg.title: Source–readout formulation. The beacon is a multi-volume readout: the source record is the quintuple of reference views (Sj,oV )4 j=0 with their local densities, and bo is the linear reader (RB3). The fourth difference is exactly the reader that annihilates every contribution that feels a folded face and returns the interior density with coefficient one (Lemma 14.25); what it discards is all information about the reference boundaries, which is the intended loss. The folding map V 7→Sj,oV is a word map in the links and intertwines the frame realization: with frames folded by the same site map and raw links by the same word, π(SZ j,oz) = Sj,oπ(z), because the path identity holds for reversed and collapsed edges. Since the densities are gauge invariant, bZ o = bo ◦π, and the allowance (RB4b) transfers by Theorem 9.4. The finite constants Kanc, Ksup, A, Z are tied to a fixed reference torus; they are explicitly not uniform in the physical period, and the lift does not make them so.
